panels.title: Online instances
panels.description: Instances whose HTTP API reports running. An instance whose API stops answering drops out within 150s.

panels.title: Protection
panels.description: Enabled only when every instance has protection enabled.

panels.title: Pause remaining
panels.description: Longest remaining protection pause across instances.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: One entry per version currently running.

panels.title: Oldest filter list update
panels.description: Age of the least recently updated filter list on any instance.

panels.title: Totals for the selected time range
Responses by code
panels.description: Response code of the answer sent to the client. `none` means no answer was recorded.

panels.title: Filtering decisions
panels.description: Every query that matched a rule: blocked, allowlisted or rewritten.

panels.title: Rule matches by filter list
panels.description: One count per matched rule. Negative and zero IDs are AdGuard Home's built-in lists.

targets.expr: sum by (filter_list_id) (rate(adguard_filter_rule_matches_total{pod=~"adguardhome-${instance}-.+"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (filter_list_id) group_left (name) max by (filter_list_id, name) (label_replace(adguard_filter_list_rules{pod=~"adguardhome-${instance}-.+"}, "filter_list_id", "$1", "id", "(.*)") * 0 + 1)

label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (filter_list_id) (rate(adguard_filter_rule_matches_total{pod=~"adguardhome-${instance}-.+",filter_list_id=~"0|-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])), "name", "Custom rules", "filter_list_id", "0"), "name", "/etc/hosts", "filter_list_id", "-1"), "name", "Blocked services", "filter_list_id", "-2"), "name", "Parental control", "filter_list_id", "-3"), "name", "Safe browsing", "filter_list_id", "-4"), "name", "Safe search", "filter_list_id", "-5")

panels.title: Processing latency
panels.description: Time AdGuard Home spent on each query, including upstream round trips.

panels.title: p95 latency, cached vs not cached
Upstream query rate
panels.description: Queries answered by an upstream, excluding cache hits and locally answered queries.

targets.expr: _time:$__range app:adguardhome pod:~"^adguardhome-${instance}-" Result.IsFiltered:false | extract_regexp "(?P<second_level_domain>[^.]+[.][^.]+)[.]?$" from QH | format if (second_level_domain:"") "<QH>" as second_level_domain | stats by (${domain}) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 50

_time:$__range app:adguardhome pod:~"^adguardhome-${instance}-" Result.IsFiltered:true | extract_regexp "(?P<second_level_domain>[^.]+[.][^.]+)[.]?$" from QH | format if (second_level_domain:"") "<QH>" as second_level_domain | stats by (${domain}) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Top 30 clients
panels.description: ClientID when the client sends one, otherwise the client IP.

targets.expr: _time:$__range app:adguardhome pod:~"^adguardhome-${instance}-" | format if (CID:*) "<CID>" as client | format if (-CID:*) "<IP>" as client | stats by (client) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 30

_time:$__range app:adguardhome pod:~"^adguardhome-${instance}-" Result.IsFiltered:true | format if (CID:*) "<CID>" as client | format if (-CID:*) "<IP>" as client | stats by (client) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 30

panels.title: Recent filtered queries
panels.description: Latest queries that matched a rule, newest first.

targets.expr: app:adguardhome pod:~"^adguardhome-${instance}-" Result.Reason:* | format if (CID:*) "<CID>" as client | format if (-CID:*) "<IP>" as client | fields _time, pod, client, QT, QH, Result.Reason, Result.Rules
